title: installer-request
description: Makes an installer (or a bootstrap token). Without `site` it is for one cabinet. With `site` it is a site installer (finding F6.R1): for up to `cabinets` cabinets of that site, and of `role` when given, for `days` days, after which it stops; every cabinet that uses it still waits for an Admin's approval.

stepUpToken.description: A one-time step-up token bound to this exact action, site and limits included.
